title: Baseball
text:
This site uses the Lahman database to explore Major League Baseball history through its data. Comparing home runs per team-game puts seasons of different lengths on a fairer footing: the sharp dips in shortened seasons look much less dramatic once games played are taken into account.
The career-leaders analysis highlights the players with the most home runs, shows which careers overlapped the steroid era, and takes a closer look at Barry Bonds season by season. Visit the analysis pages using the links in the navbar.
